Pentaho: Replace this example term. Wrap the word in <dfn>Pentaho</dfn> anywhere in a guide.md to show this definition on hover.
transformation: A data flow you design in PDI (Spoon): steps connected by hops that read, transform, and write data.
PUC: Pentaho User Console - the Pentaho Server's browser UI where published content is browsed, run, and scheduled.
PDI: Pentaho Data Integration (Kettle) - the ETL side of the platform: Spoon designer, Kitchen/Pan runners, Carte server.
BA repository: The Pentaho Server's content store. Published reports, dashboards, and analysis views live here.
data source: Where content gets its data - JDBC connections, metadata models, Mondrian cubes, CSV files, and more.
job: A PDI orchestration flow (.kjb): entries executed in sequence with success/failure hops - typically wrapping transformations.
step: One operation inside a PDI transformation (read a file, filter rows, write a table). Steps are connected by hops.
hop: The link between two PDI steps or job entries, carrying rows (transformations) or control flow (jobs).
publish: Uploading finished content from a design tool to the Pentaho Server so users can run it in the browser.
